title: Problem Definition Guidelines
content: Problem Definition assesses scope clarity and identified beneficiary group with 15 marks max.

title: Innovation Standards
content: Innovation assesses creative technical combinations and novel algorithms with 20 marks max.

title: Plagiarism Deductions
content: Plagiarism is applied as a penalty within AI score up to 15 marks for high similarity.

title: Viva Evaluation Format
content: Viva consists of 5 questions x 5 marks totaling 25 marks evaluated by faculty.
